---

Dear Sir/Madam,

We cordially invite you to submit a formal quotation for the supply of equipment as detailed below, under the referenced tender for Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL). This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is issued to assess your technical and commercial capability to fulfill the requirements of this critical infrastructure project.

---

| **S. No.** | **Item Description** | **Quantity** | **Unit** | **Technical Specification** | **Delivery Location** |
|------------|---------------------|--------------|----------|----------------------------|----------------------|

| 2 | [NEEDS REVIEW: item_name] | [NEEDS REVIEW: quantity] | Nos | [NEEDS REVIEW: technical_spec] | Palghar |

---

## **COMMERCIAL & DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS**

**Delivery Timeline:** 90 days from the date of Purchase Order issuance

**Payment Terms:** [NEEDS REVIEW: payment_terms]

---

## **QUOTATION SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS**

Your quotation must include the following mandatory elements:

1. **Unit Price Breakdown:**
   - Ex-works price per unit (INR)
   - Freight, packing, forwarding, and insurance charges (if applicable)
   - GST breakdown (CGST/SGST/IGST as applicable)
   - **Total landed cost per item at specified delivery locations**

2. **Lead Time Confirmation:**
   - Manufacturing lead time (in weeks/days)
   - Delivery schedule commitment for each delivery location

3. **Technical Compliance:**
   - Technical Compliance Sheet confirming adherence to specified standards (IS 15549 and other applicable specifications)
   - OEM authorization certificate or Letter of Authorization
   - Catalogue/datasheet for quoted items
   - Test certificates and quality assurance documentation

4. **Warranty & After-Sales Support:**
   - Warranty period and terms
   - Service support availability

5. **Validity of Quotation:** Minimum 90 days from submission date

---

## **SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS**

**Submission Deadline:** [Insert Date - typically 10-15 days from RFQ issue date]

**Submission Mode:** Email to [procurement@volksenergie.com] with subject line referencing the Tender Number

**Contact for Clarifications:**  
Procurement Department, Volks Energie  
Email: [Insert Email]  
Phone: [Insert Phone Number]

---

## **EVALUATION CRITERIA**

Quotations will be evaluated based on technical compliance, competitive pricing, delivery timeline adherence, OEM credentials, and past performance track record.

We look forward to receiving your competitive and comprehensive quotation. Should you require any clarifications regarding the specifications or terms, please contact us at the earliest convenience.

Thank you for your cooperation.

**Yours faithfully,**

**[Authorized Signatory Name]**  
**[Designation]**  
Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist  
Volks Energie  
On behalf of PGCIL
